why: E61 (PIPELINE PI-20260924-5V6UVR9J-0002): adds a `status_only: true` issue-body field to .github/workflows/gpu-burst-train.yml that reports the live values of the three arm-gate conditions (vars.GPU_BURST_ARMED, vars.GPU_PROVIDER, provider-API-key presence) as an issue comment and returns BEFORE the Burst step — regardless of GPU_BURST_ARMED's live value, so it cannot launch a pod or spend money under any repo-variable state. Read-only observability on a single workflow file (.github/**, Tier-1 surface); no src/, config/, deploy/ or order-path change. Built because no tool available to a Claude session (this one or the prior E54 session that filed the pipeline item) can read a GitHub Actions repository variable directly, and the arm-gate's live state was therefore unverifiable without either a human checking Settings->Secrets and variables->Actions, or this workflow reporting on itself without proceeding to spend. Also confirms scripts/research/dispatch_queue.py's --max-gpu-dispatches-per-run default is 1 (sane, no change needed) and that the provider API key (RUNPOD_API_KEY, per scripts/ml/gpu_burst/runpod_burst.py's only verified adapter) is the one thing this session cannot originate -- that remains an operator-only action per credentials-and-vm-mutations category 1, and is not touched by this diff.
